 How fast can you get a REAL ID in NJ before Thanksgiving?
 Damon C. Williams, USA Today Network 2026년 11월 3일 화 오후 2:37 UTC 0 New Jersey travelers hoping to get a REAL ID before Thanksgiving should start with an appointment as soon as possible, and they shouldn't assume the finished credential will be issued immediately.
 The New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission offers REAL ID appointments at agencies and mobile units statewide, including appointments for residents who want to upgrade before their current license or ID is due for renewal. 
 Is there a fast way to get a REAL ID in NJ?
 New Jersey has an emergency issuance program for some travelers leaving within 30 days, but it isn't a general rush service.
 Advertisement
 The NJ MVC REAL ID Emergency Issuance Program says qualifying appointments are handled at the Trenton Regional Center, cost an additional $80 for expedited shipping and require a minimum of three business days for processing and mailing. Appointments aren't guaranteed, and REAL IDs aren't printed on site.
 Travelers who already have another TSA-accepted identification, such as a qualifying passport, don't qualify for the emergency program. This video explains the steps and timetable. 
 Damon C. Williams is a Philadelphia-based journalist reporting on trending, breaking and service-related topics across the Mid-Atlantic region for the USA Today Network. 
 This article originally appeared on Asbury Park Press: How fast can you get a REAL ID in NJ before Thanksgiving?
